results.title: Vikram Misri says India ready to help rebuild Nepal’s flood-hit infrastructure
results.content: New Delhi is prepared to consider Nepal’s proposals for assistance and reconstruction projects following the Bhotekoshi flood.

results.title: Out as IGP, in as adviser: Nepal has seen this before
results.content: The RSP-led government’s decision to remove IGP Dan Bahadur Karki recalls a similar move in 1997, when Home Minister Bamdev Gautam replaced IGP Achyut Krishna Kharel.

results.title: Who is Manoj KC, the officer now leading Nepal Police?
results.content: A contemporary of Dan Bahadur Karki in the same police batch, KC rose to prominence for leading the investigation into the fake Bhutanese refugee scam but was later sidelined.

results.title: South Africa’s David Miller arrives to join Karnali Yaks
results.content: The experienced left-handed batter is expected to make his Nepal Premier League debut against Sudurpaschim Royals on Friday, adding firepower to a Karnali side that has won two of its first three matches.

results.title: Misri meets Khanal, discusses Nepal-India ties
results.content: The two discussed ways to deepen the multifaceted partnership and strengthen longstanding ties of friendship between Nepal and India, according to the foreign ministry.

results.title: The German who helped take Ilam tea to Europe gets a fond farewell
results.content: Thomas Holz built more than a business relationship with Nepal’s tea growers. After years of helping introduce their produce to European markets, he has retired from his job but says his bond with the farmers will endure.

results.title: A butterfly haven on Kathmandu’s doorstep
results.content: Home to 124 of Nepal’s approximately 630 butterfly species, Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park offers a rich mix of biodiversity, forest trails and tranquil escapes from the bustle of the capital.

results.title: Indian Foreign Secretary Misri arrives in Kathmandu ahead of Shah’s India visit
results.content: Talks with Nepali officials will cover a proposed economic package, Indian-funded projects and preparations for the prime minister’s visit to New Delhi.

results.title: Kathmandu Film Festival puts Nepali cinema’s past, present and future in focus
results.content: The festival screened new titles and restored classics, and brought together filmmakers to discuss the industry’s evolution and creative challenges.

results.title: Win back Indian travellers
results.content: October’s sharp drop in Indian arrivals exposes Nepal’s tourism industry’s vulnerability.

results.title: Ex-PM Nepal, ex-minister Rijal among 97 charged in Morang land swap scam
results.content: Anti-graft body seeks Rs734.956 million in damages, prison terms, fines, and confiscation of land transferred through the disputed swap.

results.title: Kathmandu expects over $2 billion in loans and grants from Delhi
results.content: Indian foreign secretary Misri is visiting Kathmandu on Wednesday to discuss the proposed package ahead of Prime Minister Shah’s India visit later this month.

results.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
results.content: Three decades after fleeing Bhutan, refugees languishing in Jhapa and Morang remain unable to access jobs, banking, and professional opportunities, while repatriation and family reunification remain unresolved.

results.title: Lumbini cruise to eight-wicket win as Pokhara suffer third defeat
results.content: Lumbini chase down a target of 98 with 50 balls to spare to move to the top of the Nepal Premier League table with five points from three matches.
